title: AutoNation and Porsche Cars North America Celebrate Opening of Porsche Hilton Head
summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE:AN), one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, announced the opening of Porsche Hilton Head, a newly constructed retail and service center designed to deliver the full Porsche luxury experience to customers and enthusiasts across Hilton Head Island, the greater Savannah area, and the wider Lowcountry. AutoNation and Porsche Cars North America leadership teams join Ray Wood, General Manager of Porsche Hilton Head, for the grand opening celebration Located at 84 Auto Mall Boulevard in Hardeeville, the two-floor, 34,000-square-foot facility is one of a select number of U.S. dealerships built to Porsche’s Generation 5 “Destination Porsche” standard. The design features a light-filled showroom, customer lounge, Porscheplatz Café, dedicated Porsche 4Kids space and service viewing areas that reflect Porsche’s focus on performance, design and hospitality.
